perks.name: Crook and Flail
perks.description: Picking up an ammo brick heals you.
perks.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Restores 70 HP.

perks.name: Gift of Sight
perks.description: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons grant you briefly increased radar resolution.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Primary Weapon Kill:
Enhanced Radar for 5 seconds.

Buff can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.
